items.computation: This is a private invoice from a company (not an authority), so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself (Rechnungsdatum = 23.05.2025). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (23.05.2025) is not counted, so counting starts 24.05.2025. 30 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) falls on Sun 22.06.2025. Since that is a Sunday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Mon 23.06.2025.
